sentences.text: Fly Agaric is a fungus, and in Mainz-Bingen it has been reported 19 times over ten years, mostly in October and November.
It is poisonous and psychoactive, with a white spore print.
It has been recorded eaten by Ariolimax columbianus, Prophysaon andersonii and Mesarion.
It is recorded as host of Chalciporus piperatus and Hypomyces hyalinus.
